modifiers: three quarter-circle wireless signal waves in bottom-left corner

readings.meaning: smart TV or media streaming setup

ambiguity: Almost identical to the disconnected cast icon (which lacks the inner rectangle), and at very small sizes can be mistaken for a generic Wi-Fi or RSS feed symbol.

reasoning: This is the standard Google Cast / Chromecast active-connection symbol, widely understood for wireless screen mirroring and media streaming to a TV. It fits a specific but real niche of home tech and office presentation tasks, though its quarter-circle waves can briefly resemble an RSS or Wi-Fi icon.
